Withering Barrage.note: Cannon Scatter Volley gains significantly increased duration. Strong on DHC DPS builds where C:SV uptime drives AoE damage; minor utility from the extra uptime overlapping with other buffs.

Jubilant Cadence.note: Stacking speed/turn plus CDR at max stacks. Mostly mobility and cooldown utility; survivability bump from agility making incoming fire miss.

Relaunch and Repair.note: Carrier-only trait: pet launch reduces captain ability recharge and heals. Strong utility on carriers, provides hull heals to self and pets for survivability.

Weapon System Synergy.note: Stacking projectile damage plus shield penetration at 10 stacks. Niche; useful on hybrid energy+torpedo builds where stacks ramp naturally.

Heart of Sol (et. al).note: Haste and faction-specific energy damage on APB/Tactical Team use. Strong cat2-style damage boost, haste contributes utility, common on space tac builds.

Out of Time.note: Stacks at high speed for CDR on low speed. Good CDR potential but self-damage penalty slightly reduces survivability; situational on pilot builds.

1.21 Terrawatts.note: CDR on captain abilities triggered by taking electrical/radiation damage. Very situational - most encounters do not inflict these damage types reliably.

Promise of Ferocity.note: Stacking weapon damage on Tactical or Pilot ability activation. Direct cat2 damage stacker; widely cited on r/stobuilds as a solid DPS trait.

Painful Memories.note: Engineering abilities apply Slow plus DoT. Good for control-oriented tank/hybrid builds, modest damage contribution via DoT.

Improved Gravity Well.note: Gravity Well duration extension and CDR. Cornerstone for science/exotic builds; damage from GW uptime, utility from CDR and added control duration.

Photonic Boarding Party.note: Removes the hangar-pet cost of Boarding Party. Minor QoL improvement; Boarding Party itself is a weak ability, limiting overall value.

Redirecting Arrays.note: Extends Beam Fire at Will duration on incoming damage. Strong on energy broadside builds where B:FAW is the primary firing mode.

Stay At Your Posts.note: Tactical ability CDR triggered by Engineering or Miracle Worker use. Good CDR for hybrid ENG/MW captains running tac abilities; damage comes indirectly via higher uptime.

Majority - Minority.note: Conditional: DRR/hardness/regen when majority HP, +damage/speed when minority. Tank mode survivability is strong; damage mode is sub-optimal since you are low HP.

Evasion Specialist.note: Shield hardness and regen on EP2E or Pilot ability. Solid shield-tanking trait, particularly on pilot-spec ships running EP2E cycles.

Hit and Run.note: During Evasive Maneuvers: +DRR; after: +damage and CritD. Balanced offensive/defensive burst; common uptime is limited by EM cooldown.

Repair Mode.note: On taking damage: heal, temp HP, DRR - but disables self. Strong survivability when triggered; self-disable is a major drawback offsetting utility.

Exotic Particle Shielding.note: Damage resistance rating on team ability activation. Straightforward survivability buff, good uptime on builds using TT/ST/ET regularly.

Heavy Tachyon Mine.note: Creates a tachyon mine on firing mode activation. Minor passive damage output; mines deal shield drain which is niche in PvE.

Charged Particle Reaction.note: Affected targets emit secondary mini-CPBs. Synergises with science/exotic CPB builds for shield-stripping AoE; niche outside sci builds.

Tachyon Dispersal.note: AoE shield DoT plus shield resistance debuff on Tachyon Beam. Good shield-stripping utility for team play, modest direct damage via the DoT.

Built To Last.note: On Hull Heal: hull regen and reduced weapon power cost. Utility from weapon cost reduction enables higher uptime; survivability via regen.

Adaptive Hull Plating.note: Stacking Max HP on Hull Heal or Command use. Strong tank trait, common on cruiser/command builds using HE/ET rotations.

Super Charged Weapons.note: On torpedo fire: +damage. Useful on torp-heavy or hybrid builds; energy-only builds benefit less. Score lower than headline r/stobuilds variant since the dataset entry reads as torp-only.

Checkmate.note: On Control: +Exotic Damage, +Projectile Damage. Sci/control builds with heavy CC rotation benefit the most; mediocre on pure energy ships.

Subsystem Redundancies.note: On Lance or Beam Overload: shield heal and hardness. Strong survivability cue on Dreadnought builds running Lance cooldowns.

Coordinated Assault.note: Mirrors B:O or C:RF onto hangar pets. Strong damage amplifier on carriers; zero value on ships without hangar bays.

Emergency Weapon Cycle.note: On EP2W: reduced weapon cost, haste. Widely regarded on r/stobuilds as a near-mandatory energy build trait; haste and sustained fire make this one of the strongest damage traits in the game.

Structural Integrity Overcharge.note: HP regen scaled by base engine power. Passive survivability; modest unless paired with high engine power builds.

Stay on Target.note: Periodic micro-torpedo while target is in forward arc. Passive minor damage; benefits front-loaded ships that keep targets in arc.
